# RankMonk
> RankMonk.ai provides autonomous Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) SaaS intelligence.

## Canonical Information
- Website: https://rankmonk.ai
- Brand Name: RankMonk
- Industry: AI Search & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO / GEO)

## Core Solutions & Offerings
- 11-Test GEO Diagnostic Engine with Before/After Actionable Code Remediation
- Multi-Model AEO Visibility Matrix (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok)
- Competitive AI Share of Voice & Benchmarking
- AI Referral Traffic Studio & GA4 Attribution
- Content Gap Studio & 1-Click Editorial Brief Generator
- llms.txt Protocol Standard Generator & Crawler Directives Auditor
